newsitem.title: UK: Water stks under pressure as govt summit begins.
newsitem.headline: Water stks under pressure as govt summit begins.

text.p: Water stocks were feeling the pressure on Monday after the government-prompted industry summit on water resource problems kicked off in London and the industry regulator pledged new annual targets to plug leaks.

Thames Water Plc led the falls with a 13 1/2 pence decline to 672. It has one of the highest leakage rates in the sector, losing 38 percent of all treated water which goes into its mains, according to figures from regulator Ofwat. United Utilities Plc was down 10 pence at 665, Yorkshire Water Plc was down nine and a half pence at 362 and Severn Trent Water was down 12 at 775.
